  - `PVN Power Generation Portfolio` (gas/LNG assets)
  - `MOIT Investment Licensing Portal` (BOT/foreign developer approvals)
- **Limitations:** Exact unit configurations, phased CODs, and ownership transfers may vary slightly across government bulletins. This table excludes industrial captive plants <30 MWe, biomass/waste-to-energy, and projects cancelled prior to PDP8.
